brt_001: You can recognise it by its species alone among the plane trees lining the embankment, easy to miss unless you already know it is there. It stands in the small park on Vajanského nábrežie.
brt_002: You can recognise it by its crown, cleared well above the surrounding rooftops. It stands on Rudnayovo námestie, in front of St. Martin's Cathedral.
brt_003: You can recognise it in May and June by upright spikes of lavender flowers appearing before the leaves fill in. It stands in Park Škarniclova, by the former dormitory.
brt_004: You can recognise it by its crown directly overhead as you climb the public stairway, its base close to a private plot's boundary. It stands at the top of the Šulekova stairway.
brt_005: You can recognise it by its pale, papery bark peeling in thin horizontal strips, the smallest tree on this list. It stands on the street in front of Mišíkova 36.
brt_007: You can recognise it by its trunk, 7.05 metres round, standing in the open with no fence between the road and it. It stands beside Limbašská cesta, near the former Strapák's Mill.
